title: Scripture Quotation in Generative AI: explainer (Apologist AI)
source: Scripture Quotation in Generative AI, Jake Carlson, The Apologist Project, Aug 5 2026 (Drive PDF 1xu7Sg9VdnpxiODHOAtdoeXl57y0TIXUo). Every claim maps to a page in RESEARCH.md.

lines.text: Ask an AI to quote the Bible, and the words often come back wrong.
lines.cap: Ask an AI / to quote the Bible, / and the words often / come back wrong.

lines.text: It's not a bug. A model writes by guessing likely words, and every guess can drift.
lines.cap: It's not a bug. / A model writes / by guessing likely words, / and every guess can drift.

lines.text: So the fix isn't a smarter model or new settings. It's the method.
lines.cap: So the fix isn't / a smarter model / or new settings. / It's the method.

lines.text: Alone, the model was exactly right about a third of the time. With web search, under half. Handed the passage, 93 percent. Using a lookup tool, 96.
lines.cap: Alone, the model / was exactly right / about a third of the time. / With web search, / under half. / Handed the passage, / 93 percent. / Using a lookup tool, 96.

lines.text: One method got every English quote exactly right.
lines.cap: One method got / every English quote / exactly right.

lines.text: The model never writes the verse. It leaves a placeholder, like John 3:16, and the software fills in the exact text from a licensed Bible source.
lines.cap: The model never / writes the verse. / It leaves a placeholder, / like John 3:16, / and the software / fills in the exact text / from a licensed / Bible source.

lines.text: If anything fails, you see the reference with no verse. A gap you can spot, never a misquote.
lines.cap: If anything fails, / you see the reference / with no verse. / A gap you can spot, / never a misquote.

lines.text: That's how Apologist AI quotes Scripture. Read the study, and try it at apologist.ai.
